SEL Level 1 · Reading Others: Body Clues

Learn

Bodies Talk Too

🧍 Our bodies show feelings, even

when we don't talk.

🔍 Look at the head, arms, hands,

and feet.

💬 Then we say the clue that told us.

Practice

How Do They Feel?

👀 Read the body clues.

✋ Pick 1, 2, or 3 on your fingers.

💬 Say: “The clue was ___.”

SEL Level 1 · Reading Others: Body Clues

🃏 Card 1 of 4

🙇 Their head is down.

They walk very slowly to

class.

Pick! 1

😢 sad 2 excited 3 mad

SEL Level 1 · Reading Others: Body Clues

✅ Answer · Card 1 of 4

Sad

Head down and a slow

walk are sad clues. Tired

can look like this too, so

check the face!

SEL Level 1 · Reading Others: Body Clues

🃏 Card 2 of 4

🙌 They jump up and

down and throw their

arms up high.

Pick! 1

😢 sad 2 scared 3 excited

SEL Level 1 · Reading Others: Body Clues

✅ Answer · Card 2 of 4

Excited

Jumping and arms up

high are excited clues.

SEL Level 1 · Reading Others: Body Clues

🃏 Card 3 of 4

💪 Their arms are

crossed, and their feet

stomp on the floor.

Pick! 1

😠 mad 2 happy 3 tired

SEL Level 1 · Reading Others: Body Clues

✅ Answer · Card 3 of 4

Mad

Crossed arms and

stomping feet are mad

clues.

SEL Level 1 · Reading Others: Body Clues

🃏 Card 4 of 4

🫨 Their hands shake,

and they hide their face

behind a book.

Pick! 1

😊 happy 2 scared 3 excited

SEL Level 1 · Reading Others: Body Clues

✅ Answer · Card 4 of 4

Scared

Shaking hands and hiding

are scared clues.
